faq.headline: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about project scope, collaboration, and timelines.
faq.q1: What web technologies do you specialize in?
faq.a1: I primarily build with modern web frameworks and tools including Astro, TypeScript, UnoCSS, and SolidJS on the frontend, with Vite+, Hono, Cloudflare, and PlanetScale on the backend. This produces fast, lightweight, and cost-efficient edge deployments.
faq.q2: Can you audit or optimize my existing website?
faq.a2: Yes. I provide in-depth performance and security audits identifying bottleneck assets, unoptimized bundles, and missing security headers, along with direct code refactoring to bring your scores to 100/100 and A+.
faq.q3: How are projects scoped and priced?
faq.a3: Engagements can be structured as fixed-scope project milestones for well-defined builds, or on a flexible sprint/retainer basis for ongoing development and advisory. Every project includes clear deliverables and timelines upfront.
faq.a4: Reach out through the contact form with a brief summary of your project or requirements. I'll get back to you within 24â€“48 hours to discuss specifications, timeline, and next steps.
